```{r load-libraries}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(ggrepel)
```

## Load Data

```{r load-data}
# Set base path relative to this scripts directory
base_path <- normalizePath("..", winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

# Load SpliceAI v3.1 data
spliceai_data <- fread(file.path(base_path, "results", "all_spliceai_scores_v3.1.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE
)

cat("\nLoaded SpliceAI v3.1 data:\n")
cat("  Total rows:", nrow(spliceai_data), "\n")
cat("  Total columns:", ncol(spliceai_data), "\n")
```

## Restrict to the Recount-filtered decoy set

```{r recount-filter}
# The MSA/SpliceAI scan was run on DecoysInConservedGenes50thpercentile.bed, which
# is NOT the same list as the protein-coding decoy set. Of the 4,886 decoyIDs in
# the score table, 4,577 appear in Decoys_proteincoding_splicescores.bed and 309
# do not - those 309 cannot be judged by the Recount filter at all, because they
# were never in the set that was queried against Recount.
#
# DROP_UNASSESSED controls what happens to those 309:
#   TRUE  - use the filtered BED strictly as a whitelist (keeps 4,306). This is
#           the "the filtered BED is the input" reading.
#   FALSE - remove only the decoys Recount positively flagged, and keep the
#           unassessed ones (keeps 4,615).
# Either way the 309 are reported below rather than disappearing silently.
DROP_UNASSESSED <- TRUE

filtered_bed_path <- file.path(
  base_path, "data", "Decoys", "Decoys_proteincoding_recount_filtered.bed"
)
full_bed_path <- file.path(
  base_path, "data", "Decoys", "Decoys_proteincoding_splicescores.bed"
)

if (!file.exists(filtered_bed_path)) {
  stop(
    "Recount-filtered BED not found: ", filtered_bed_path, "\n",
    "  This file is generated, not checked in. Run:\n",
    "    python3 scripts/filter_decoys_by_recount.py \\\n",
    "      --loci-bed data/Decoys/Decoys_proteincoding_splicescores.bed \\\n",
    "      --junctions results/tcgajunctions.tsv results/srajunctions.tsv results/gtexjunctions.tsv \\\n",
    "      --out-bed data/Decoys/Decoys_proteincoding_recount_filtered.bed"
  )
}

# decoyID key is <gene>_<bed_start>, matching filter_decoys_by_recount.py
bed_keys <- function(path) {
  b <- fread(path, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, select = 1:6,
    col.names = c("chr", "start", "end", "gene", "score", "strand"))
  paste0(b$gene, "_", b$start)
}
keep_ids <- bed_keys(filtered_bed_path)
all_ids <- bed_keys(full_bed_path)

n_before <- nrow(spliceai_data)
in_full <- spliceai_data$decoyID %in% all_ids
in_keep <- spliceai_data$decoyID %in% keep_ids
n_flagged <- sum(in_full & !in_keep)
n_unassessed <- sum(!in_full)

spliceai_data <- if (DROP_UNASSESSED) {
  spliceai_data[in_keep]
} else {
  spliceai_data[in_keep | !in_full]
}

cat("\nRecount filtering of the SpliceAI score table:\n")
cat("  decoyIDs before          :", n_before, "\n")
cat("  removed - Recount-annotated:", n_flagged, "\n")
cat("  not in protein-coding BED :", n_unassessed,
  if (DROP_UNASSESSED) "(dropped: DROP_UNASSESSED = TRUE)" else "(kept: DROP_UNASSESSED = FALSE)", "\n")
cat("  decoyIDs after           :", nrow(spliceai_data), "\n")
if (!"HNRNPH1_179620582" %in% spliceai_data$decoyID) {
  stop("HNRNPH1_179620582 did not survive the Recount filter - the figure below would be empty.")
}
cat("  HNRNPH1_179620582 retained: yes\n")
```

## Parse SpliceAI Data

```{r parse-spliceai}
# Function to parse SpliceAI v3.1 format: [max1][pos1][max2][pos2][d]
# Extract max1 (canonical splice score)
parse_spliceai_max1 <- function(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || value == "" || value == "[-1.0][-1][-1.0][-1][-1.0]") {
    return(NA)
  }
  match_result <- str_match(value, "\\[([\\d.-]+)\\]\\[(\\d+)\\]\\[([\\d.-]+)\\]\\[(\\d+)\\]\\[([\\d.-]+)\\]")
  if (is.na(match_result[1])) {
    return(NA)
  }
  max1 <- as.numeric(match_result[2])
  if (is.na(max1) || max1 == -1.0) {
    return(NA)
  }
  return(max1)
}

# Function to parse SpliceAI v3.1 format: [max1][pos1][max2][pos2][d]
# Extract max2 (decoy splice score)
parse_spliceai_max2 <- function(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || value == "" || value == "[-1.0][-1][-1.0][-1][-1.0]") {
    return(NA)
  }
  match_result <- str_match(value, "\\[([\\d.-]+)\\]\\[(\\d+)\\]\\[([\\d.-]+)\\]\\[(\\d+)\\]\\[([\\d.-]+)\\]")
  if (is.na(match_result[1])) {
    return(NA)
  }
  max2 <- as.numeric(match_result[4])
  if (is.na(max2) || max2 == -1.0) {
    return(NA)
  }
  return(max2)
}

# Function to parse SpliceAI v3.1 format: [max1][pos1][max2][pos2][d]
# Extract pos2 (position of max2)
parse_spliceai_pos2 <- function(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || value == "" || value == "[-1.0][-1][-1.0][-1][-1.0]") {
    return(NA)
  }
  match_result <- str_match(value, "\\[([\\d.-]+)\\]\\[(\\d+)\\]\\[([\\d.-]+)\\]\\[(\\d+)\\]\\[([\\d.-]+)\\]")
  if (is.na(match_result[1])) {
    return(NA)
  }
  pos2 <- as.integer(match_result[5])
  if (is.na(pos2) || pos2 == -1) {
    return(NA)
  }
  return(pos2)
}

# Get species columns (all except decoyID)
species_cols <- setdiff(colnames(spliceai_data), "decoyID")

# Parse all data into long format
parsed_data_list <- list()

for (species in species_cols) {
  # Extract max1, max2, and pos2 for each species
  max1_values <- sapply(spliceai_data[[species]], parse_spliceai_max1)
  max2_values <- sapply(spliceai_data[[species]], parse_spliceai_max2)
  pos2_values <- sapply(spliceai_data[[species]], parse_spliceai_pos2)

  # Create data frame for this species
  species_data <- data.frame(
    decoyID = spliceai_data$decoyID,
    species = species,
    max1 = max1_values,
    max2 = max2_values,
    pos2 = pos2_values,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  parsed_data_list[[species]] <- species_data
}

# Combine all species data
all_spliceai_parsed <- bind_rows(parsed_data_list)

# Filter out NA values
all_spliceai_parsed <- all_spliceai_parsed %>%
  filter(!is.na(max1) | !is.na(max2))

cat("\nParsed SpliceAI data:\n")
cat("  Total data points:", nrow(all_spliceai_parsed), "\n")
cat("  Data points with max1:", sum(!is.na(all_spliceai_parsed$max1)), "\n")
cat("  Data points with max2:", sum(!is.na(all_spliceai_parsed$max2)), "\n")
cat("  Data points with pos2:", sum(!is.na(all_spliceai_parsed$pos2)), "\n")
```

# Decoy HNRNPH1 max2 vs pos2 scatter plot

```{r scatter-plot-hnrnph1-max2-pos2}
# Load species mapping to get common names
species_mapping <- fread(file.path(base_path, "data", "tree_to_clade_mapping.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE
)

# Create lookup: species_id -> matched_common_name
species_id_to_common <- setNames(species_mapping$matched_common_name, species_mapping$species_id)
# Create lookup: species_id -> clade
species_id_to_clade <- setNames(species_mapping$clade, species_mapping$species_id)

# Extract all parsed rows for HNRNPH1_179620582 and annotate species metadata
hnrnph1_all <- all_spliceai_parsed %>%
  filter(decoyID == "HNRNPH1_179620582") %>%
  mutate(
    common_name = ifelse(species %in% names(species_id_to_common),
      species_id_to_common[species],
      species
    ),
    clade = ifelse(species %in% names(species_id_to_clade),
      species_id_to_clade[species],
      "Unknown"
    )
  )

# Save all parsed rows for this decoy as TSV
fwrite(
  hnrnph1_all,
  file = file.path(base_path, "data", "Decoys", "hnrnph1_spliceaispecies.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

# Subsets for positional scatterplots
hnrnph1_data_max2 <- hnrnph1_all %>% filter(!is.na(max2) & !is.na(pos2))

cat("\nHNRNPH1_179620582 data:\n")
cat("  Total parsed rows saved:", nrow(hnrnph1_all), "\n")
cat("  Species with max2 and pos2:", nrow(hnrnph1_data_max2), "\n")
cat("  Output TSV: ", file.path(base_path, "data", "Decoys", "hnrnph1_spliceaispecies.tsv"), "\n", sep = "")

# --- Collapse the source clades into the four plotted groups --------------------
# The mapping file's clade column splits mammals across five labels. For this
# figure all mammals are shown together, split only by placental status:
#   Placental (Eutheria) = Afrotheria + Euarchontoglires + Laurasiatheria +
#                          Primate, plus dasNov3 (Armadillo). NB: Armadillo sits
#                          in the catch-all "Mammal" clade but is a xenarthran,
#                          i.e. placental - it must not fall in with the pouched
#                          mammals below.
#   Other mammals        = the marsupials and the monotreme (Opossum, Tasmanian
#                          devil, Wallaby, Platypus).
# Sarcopterygii (alligator, turtles, lizard, coelacanth, X. tropicalis) is
# dropped from this figure entirely. Aves and Fish are retained as-is.
PLACENTAL_CLADES <- c("Afrotheria", "Euarchontoglires", "Laurasiatheria", "Primate")
PLACENTAL_EXTRA <- c("dasNov3") # Armadillo (Xenarthra)

hnrnph1_data_max2 <- hnrnph1_data_max2 %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      clade %in% PLACENTAL_CLADES | species %in% PLACENTAL_EXTRA ~ "Placental mammals",
      clade == "Mammal" ~ "Other mammals",
      clade == "Aves" ~ "Aves",
      clade == "Fish" ~ "Fish",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_ # Sarcopterygii -> dropped
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group,
    levels = c("Placental mammals", "Other mammals", "Aves", "Fish")
  ))

cat("\nSpecies per plotted group (Sarcopterygii dropped):\n")
print(table(hnrnph1_data_max2$group))

# Only these species carry a text label; every other point is unlabelled.
LABEL_SPECIES <- c(
  "Cat", "Pig", "Human", "Rat", "Cow",
  "Gorilla", "Chimp", "Baboon", "Mouse"
)
label_data <- hnrnph1_data_max2 %>% filter(common_name %in% LABEL_SPECIES)
cat("  Labelled species found:", nrow(label_data), "of", length(LABEL_SPECIES), "\n")
missing_labels <- setdiff(LABEL_SPECIES, label_data$common_name)
if (length(missing_labels) > 0) {
  cat(
    "  WARNING - requested label absent from data:",
    paste(missing_labels, collapse = ", "), "\n"
  )
}

# Palette validated for colour-vision deficiency (OKLab dE, Machado 2009 sev 1.0,
# all pairs). Placental/other mammals are deliberately adjacent hues (red/orange)
# so the two read as one mammalian block. Two pairs sit in WARN bands - the orange
# is below 3:1 against a white surface, and red-vs-green falls to dE 6.7 under
# deuteranopia - so `group` is redundantly encoded by SHAPE as well as fill, and
# every point carries a dark stroke. Do not drop the shape scale to "tidy up".
GROUP_FILL <- c(
  "Placental mammals" = "#A00F0F", # dark red
  "Other mammals"     = "#E68A00", # dark orange
  "Aves"              = "#2a78d6",
  "Fish"              = "#008300"
)
GROUP_SHAPE <- c(
  "Placental mammals" = 21, # circle
  "Other mammals"     = 24, # triangle
  "Aves"              = 22, # square
  "Fish"              = 23  # diamond
)

if (nrow(hnrnph1_data_max2) > 0) {
  p_hnrnph1_max2_pos2 <- ggplot(
    hnrnph1_data_max2,
    aes(x = pos2, y = max2, fill = group, shape = group)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9, colour = "grey20", stroke = 0.6) +
    # The nine labelled species are redrawn larger with a black ring. In the
    # dense mammalian column a leader line can otherwise pass close enough to a
    # neighbouring point to be misread as pointing at it; this makes the label
    # target unambiguous.
    # show.legend = FALSE: this layer must not touch the legend keys, or the
    # "Placental mammals" key inherits the black ring and reads as if the ring
    # meant "placental" rather than "labelled".
    geom_point(
      data = label_data, size = 6, alpha = 1, colour = "black",
      stroke = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    # Labels for the nine focus species only
    geom_text_repel(
      data = label_data,
      aes(label = common_name),
      size = 6,
      fontface = "bold",
      colour = "grey10",
      min.segment.length = 0,
      segment.size = 0.4,
      segment.color = "grey40",
      box.padding = 0.9,
      point.padding = 0.5,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = GROUP_FILL, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = GROUP_SHAPE, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    # fill and shape map to the same variable, so ggplot merges them into a
    # single legend; set override.aes on one guide only or it warns.
    guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6))) +
    labs(
      title = "HNRNPH1_179620582 Decoy Element Retains Locus Position Across Species",
      subtitle = "SpliceAI donor scores calculated across whole intron multiple alignment file for maximum position",
      x = "Loci distance from canonical 5' splice site (nt)",
      y = "Consensus Sequence Strength (SpliceAI Donor Score)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 15, colour = "grey30"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16, colour = "grey20"),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(1.4, "lines"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.line.x = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      axis.line.y = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5)
    )

  print(p_hnrnph1_max2_pos2)
  pdf(file.path(base_path, "figures", "hnrnph1_max2_pos2_scatterplot.pdf"), width = 16, height = 11)
  print(p_hnrnph1_max2_pos2)
  dev.off()
  ggsave(
    file.path(base_path, "figures", "hnrnph1_max2_pos2_scatterplot.png"),
    p_hnrnph1_max2_pos2,
    width = 16, height = 11, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  cat("  Output PDF: ", file.path(base_path, "results", "hnrnph1_max2_pos2_scatterplot.pdf"), "\n", sep = "")

  # Print summary statistics
  cat("\nSummary statistics (max2 plot):\n")
  cat("  Mean max2:", round(mean(hnrnph1_data_max2$max2, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
  cat("  Median max2:", round(median(hnrnph1_data_max2$max2, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
  cat("  Min max2:", round(min(hnrnph1_data_max2$max2, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
  cat("  Max max2:", round(max(hnrnph1_data_max2$max2, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
  cat("  Mean pos2:", round(mean(hnrnph1_data_max2$pos2, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
  cat("  Median pos2:", round(median(hnrnph1_data_max2$pos2, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
  cat("  Min pos2:", min(hnrnph1_data_max2$pos2, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("  Max pos2:", max(hnrnph1_data_max2$pos2, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
} else {
  cat("  No data found for HNRNPH1_179620582 with both max2 and pos2\n")
}
```
